items.name: Opening
items.description: A serif line and a huge sans-serif headline settle over a drifting lilac-to-amber gradient, underlined by a hand-drawn curve.

items.name: Builder
items.description: Three document cards drop onto a dotted path that a glowing dot travels along.

items.name: Network
items.description: Three dotted bubbles appear one by one and link up with thin curved lines.

items.name: Private activity
items.description: A toggle flips on while a grid of small crosses fills in beside the headline.

items.name: Side projects
items.description: Dotted bubbles join up along a winding line, each one labelled.

items.name: Contributions
items.description: A contribution grid lights up square by square under a two-line headline.

items.name: Repository
items.description: A folder outline draws in and branches out into three files.

items.name: Publish
items.description: A glowing dot travels a dotted path through two labelled stops to its destination.

items.name: Profile README
items.description: A profile card draws itself in outline: avatar, file list and lines of text.

items.name: Networking typography
items.description: A giant word fills the frame, then an italic serif word settles over it on a dotted orbit.

items.name: README typography
items.description: A big sans-serif word with an italic serif line beneath, on a blue gradient.

items.name: Closing
items.description: A closing headline in sans and italic serif over a warm orange gradient, with a curve sweeping through.
